SM-518AB7BA.reason: Require: a route may name a provider string the config does not declare (routes.py keeps such a route), and trying it raises a bare ValueError that reaches the caller when it is the last route. A requirement should say such a route fails as the public ProviderNotFoundError, a ConfigurationError that exists for this case and is never raised today, while the router may still try the routes after it.
